findings.source: Placera: GE Aerospace Backlog, Demand Strength Likely to Offset Oil Price Concerns, Morgan Stanley Says
findings.excerpt: GE's roughly $210 billion backlog, including about $170 billion in Commercial Services, provides visibility into Q2 and full-year 2026, supported by strong "spare parts"demand and "shop visit"activity. Analysts at Morgan Stanley said "demand continues to outpace supply,"pointing to rising spare parts delinquency alongside revenue growth, according to the report.
